content.title: What time does the Sidemen Charity Match 2026 kick-off today? Teams in full
content.text: Published April 18, 2026 9:25am Updated April 18, 2026 9:26am KSI will be part of the YouTube Allstars team (Picture: Getty) The Sidemen Charity Match returns this afternoon with millions of pounds set to be raised for charitable causes. The hugely popular event, which was founded by the Sidemen YouTubers in 2016, has raised over £8m for charity across its previous six editions. This year’s Wembley showdown will look and feel slightly different, with several members of the Sidemen team playing for the YouTube Allstars instead. The match will need to go some way to topping the excitement and drama delivered by last year’s game, which finished as a rather incredible 9-9 draw before the Allstars prevailed 5-4 in a penalty shootout. Here is your full guide to the Sidemen Charity Match 2026, including what time it starts, how to watch and the all-important teams. What time does the match start? The game will kick-off at 3pm today (Saturday, April 18). Wembley witnessed a bonkers game last year (Picture: Sidemen) The 90,000 tickets sold out in just three hours, raising a total of £4.7m for the Bright Side and M7 Education charities. This is the second-successive year the charity game has been staged at Wembley, with previous editions taking place at St Mary’s (2016), The Valley (2017, 2018, 2022) and the London Stadium (2023). How to watch The game will be available to watch for free on the Sidemen YouTube channel. Teams Sidemen members KSI, Miniminter and Behzinga are the players who have switched to the YouTube Allstars team this year. Sidemen Charity Match line-ups Sidemen FC Manager: Jack Joseph 0 – Deji 3 – Marlon 4 – Zerkaa 7 – Arthur TV 9 – Aminematue 10 – ChrisMD 12 – xQc 14 – Adapt 19 – Jynxzi 21 – TBJZL 22 – Niko 23 – AB 30 – AJ Shabeel 61 – LazarBeam 67 – Lacy 77 – Wroetoshaw 123 – Vikkstar123 YouTube Allstars Manager: Calfreezy 1 – Sketch 4 – KSI 5 – CarryMinati 7 – Miniminter 8 – George Clarkey 11 – Ibai 13 – AngryGinge 14 – Squeezie 15 – MrWhoseTheBoss 17 – Nykchazza 22 – Fanum 25 – Behzinga 28 – Danny Aarons 66 – Stable Ronaldo 67 – El Rubius 88 – ItalianBach 99 – Jasontheween Will extra-time be used if it ends a draw? No – the match will head straight to penalties should the game finish level after 90 minutes. Last year’s clash was the first time that penalties have been used to determine the winner. Who wins? Previous results The Sidemen have the better overall record with four victories notched up compared to the two wins by the YouTube Allstars. 2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars 2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars 2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars 2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars 2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars 2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on penalties) Arrow MORE: Tourist who ‘visited isolated tribe with can of Diet Coke’ is held in jail Arrow MORE: Sidemen Charity Match 2026: Start time and line-ups for Wembley showdown Arrow MORE: YouTuber threw money on the floor to make ‘Jew traps’
